title: Device Studio implementation handoff materials audit
scope: Selected accepted v6 laptop/phone references plus source/replay inputs; v3/v4 model candidates and source rights metadata.

authority.acceptance: scenarios/device-studio/docs/internal/ACCEPTANCE.md: approved delivery agreement; v6 establishes direction only and new actual-renderer output needs initial representative-look approval.
authority.v6_status: Historical visual direction reference. Laptop uses inherited v2 generated plate; phone has independent generated plate. Neither is proof of calibrated hardware. No visual approval asserted here.
authority.v5: Rejected appearance remains rejected; do not use v5 as accepted look or erase its negative benchmark role.
authority.E1_vs_shared_owner: E1's narrower product outcome does not prohibit later shared-owner integration when the required schema route crosses ownership. E1 explicitly includes the Device Studio proto schema and governed generated outputs. Canonical source is packages/proto/schemas/device-studio/v1/<domain>/*.proto; use cd packages/proto && make generate SCENARIO=device-studio, then cd packages/proto && make verify-committed-gen. Existing shared schemas include notes/attachments.proto, notes.proto, shared/errors.proto and shared/health.proto; projects.proto is newly present for the E1 project API. Observed workspace overlap: packages/proto/schemas/device-studio/v1/projects/projects.proto and generated Device Studio Go/Connect/TypeScript/Python trees are currently untracked, while the E1 API/CLI/UI and E1 epoch files are also present as untracked. This is concrete path-level overlap between E1 work and shared Proto-owned schema/generated outputs, within E1's declared proto allowance. It does not prove the governed owner command ran successfully or that generated artifacts pass verification; no verifier was run for this audit.

source_rights_and_limits: v6 source recordings are locally retained real responsive frontend captures with fictional fixture UI; provenance says not native OS/app/backend proof. No third-party live-data rights claim is made.

Phone v6 plate is built-in imagegen; receipt does not report model, seed or cost. Generated imagery has no explicit third-party redistribution license attestation in the receipt; treat as private historical reference pending rights determination.
Laptop v6 plate inherits v2 imagegen output; model, seed and cost are unreported. It is a selected historical reference, not a cleared product asset.

v3/v4 imported MacBook is CC BY 4.0 with author/source attribution retained; adapt/bundle subject to attribution and original license terms. Open static assembly only; articulation/closed pose not qualified.
v3/v4 imported iPhone 15 Pro Max is CC BY 4.0 per embedded/upstream attribution; preserve creator credit and license. It is distinct from v6 generated approximate phone.

v3 authored iPhone 16 Pro was built from Apple reference photos/dimensions; reference review states Apple images are reference-only/copyrighted and no manufacturer endorsement. Authored geometry has no third-party model license identified in its manifest; verify project ownership/redistribution before bundling.
